name: Tsujidou-san no Virgin Road
original_name: 辻堂さんのバージンロード
source:
This is the fandisk for Tsujidou-san Jun'ai Road. In addition to the after stories for the 3 main heroines, it will add routes for the most popular subheroines, Azusa and Yoiko.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/] Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《辻堂小姐的纯爱之路》的Fan Disc。除了三位主要女主角的后日谈外，还追加了最受欢迎的副角色梓和夜子的路线。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
